Messages.Author: Matt
Messages.Body:
Some people were asking about whether a leather jacket is worth it, or
whether it is overpowered.

Well then the above answer sure increases it's apparent value in my
eyes. If you ever leave minions untapped to block, and you like for
them to have equipment then leather jacket works great. It doesn't
matter who had the jacket and the other equipment at the start of the
turn, maybe one guy had a sports bike, a flamethrower, a flak jacket,
and some IR goggles. You can use that guy to bleed or whatever. Then
after the action, you can have another minion equip all the goodies,
then untap so he can be there to block.

I'm sure someone has mentioned this before but I had trouble finding
an answer to my question earlier by searching the forum.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <589ebf00.01122...@posting.google.com>, Matt

<mathi...@hotmail.com> writes:
>Some people were asking about whether a leather jacket is worth it, or
>whether it is overpowered.

This seems unlikely - though it is certainly a good card.

It can only be /used/ once, so even if you keep passing it round, it
will eventually burn.

>Well then the above answer sure increases it's apparent value in my
>eyes. If you ever leave minions untapped to block, and you like for
>them to have equipment then leather jacket works great. It doesn't
>matter who had the jacket and the other equipment at the start of the
>turn, maybe one guy had a sports bike, a flamethrower, a flak jacket,
>and some IR goggles. You can use that guy to bleed or whatever. Then
>after the action, you can have another minion equip all the goodies,
>then untap so he can be there to block.

Sure. Or you could use Heidelberg Castle (which would work without
regards to Leather Jacket). And when your Leather Jacket goes boom, so
does the leaving them untapped bit.

It provides a very obvious target for theft or destruction, once people
see it as the lynch-pin of a combo. (Bear in mind that with the
Temptation of Greater Power deck, a number of people were seeing ToGP as
the most vulnerable area rather than looking at the Justicar. So when
people spot this may be tricky.)

You'll also need to pass the equip action. Repeatedly. Since it's not
a weapon, you can't use Disguised Weapon. Though if you're getting out
a lot of equipment (as above) and are playing the Lasombra, you could
always use Pier 13 and try and max out that one action (possible, but
requires a little luck on the card flow, perhaps).

Each transfer, however, will also require its own stealth. Anyone with
a newspaper can block a +1 stealth action. Assuming you have, say,
Felicia Mostrom (no equipment) taking them off Anson, the Equip action
(to transfer equipment) is taken by Felicia. So she's going to need to
be able to defend herself if she's blocked. And if you're playing
equipment, you may not have that many transient cards. Or you're going
to have to double up on equipment on both of them - which then loses
some of the benefits of being able to pile them up.

And if you *do* get blocked, that's two tapped minions and neither of
them untapped. Less useful.

You might also find Metro Underground to be potentially useful, if you
can afford the pool. (Difficult in such an equipment intensive deck.)

So, sure, it's a possible angle of attack. And it's potentially a very
useful one. I don't think it's getting even close to "too powerful"
though.
